page.title: Style
page.description: Outfits, beauty, rings and decor in one place, with an inspiration board so everything matches. It saves automatically and everyone planning with you can see it.

loadError.title: We couldn't load your style
loadError.text: Check your connection and try again in a moment.

form.vendorHint: This only links: nothing changes in Vendors.

errors.price: Enter a valid amount, for example 1200 or 1,200.50.

budget.added: Added to the budget as a pending expense.
budget.addError: We couldn't add it to the budget.

outfit.title: Outfits
outfit.description: One look per person: the couple, bridesmaids, groomsmen, the little ones… with their shop, price and progress.

empty.title: No looks yet
empty.text: Start with the couple and add everyone else whenever you like. Note the outfit, where you are buying it and how far along it is.

fittings.title: Fittings
fittings.description: Fittings are outfit appointments in your agenda, so they also show up on the Overview.
fittings.empty: You haven't added any fittings yet.

form.outfitPlaceholder: E.g. Crepe dress with a bateau neckline

beauty.title: Beauty
beauty.description: Hair and makeup: who is doing it, for whom, when the trial is and what time they start on the wedding day.

empty.title: No hair or makeup noted yet
empty.text: Add who does your hair or makeup, the trial date and the time on the wedding day.

form.forWhoPlaceholder: E.g. Bride, mother of the bride
form.dayTimeHint: What time they need to start with you.

routine.title: Pre-wedding routine
routine.description: Optional: treatments you want to do before the wedding, so they don't pile up at the last minute.

suggestions.haircut: Haircut or colour touch-up, 1 week before
suggestions.hydration: Daily hydration for the last month

rings.title: Rings and wedding bands
rings.description: A single sheet for the bands: model, shop, sizes, engraving and when they're collected.

fields.modelPlaceholder: E.g. Flat white gold band, 4 mm

decor.title: Decor and flowers
decor.description: The decor elements with their vendor and status, and below them the inspiration board and your wedding colours.

empty.title: No elements yet
empty.text: Tap one of the ideas above or add your own: centrepieces, bouquet, ceremony, photo booth…

form.title: Your own name
form.titleHint: If you leave it empty, the type is shown.
form.titlePlaceholder: E.g. Peony centrepieces on the top table

palette.title: Colour palette
palette.description: Your wedding colours, handy for when you talk to florists, stationers or dress makers.
palette.invalidHex: Enter a valid code, for example #927AAC.

mood.title: Moodboard
mood.description: Your inspiration board: paste an image link or upload photos from your device.
mood.full: You've reached the limit of {{max}} images.

empty.title: Your board is empty
empty.text: Keep bouquets, tables, colours, dresses… everything that makes you think “that's it”. It will be easier to explain to whoever helps you.
